integrity: No third-party proof is represented as novel. The exact BCZ map and its invariant measure are prior work; the new claim concerns the proportional-time rare-event-conditioned exit law.
scientific_limitations: Conditioned invariant-area ensemble; scaling only for fixed compact macroscopic windows strictly below 1/2. No claim of finite-Farey-order uniformity, full rare-event point-process convergence, or independent priority verification.
title: Pareto branch-exit clock and macroscopic relaxation after rare BCZ roof excursions
